articles.summary: Atmus Filtration Technologies Inc. (Atmus; NYSE: ATMU) (“Atmus”), a global leader in filtration and media solutions, today released its 2025 Sustainability Report. This second annual report showcases how Atmus is creating a better future by protecting what is important. “As a global company, we know it is a responsibility and privilege to influence and shape a sustainable future,” said Steph Disher, Chief Executive Officer and President of Atmus. “We are happy to share our progress in protecting our people, our customers and our planet.” The company’s 2025 Sustainability Report details how Atmus protects what is important to global business and the energy transition through science that safeguards, authentic sustainability and people-led leadership. Key topics covered include: Our People: Employee health, safety and wellbeing; inclusion and diversity of perspective; talent attraction, retention, development and training. Our Planet: Emissions reduction; operational resources usage;
articles.title: Atmus Filtration Technologies Releases Annual Sustainability Report
